items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: So you left Woody Herman and then you ended up with Stan Kenton. / Yeah.

ctx.x: I think it came as a surprise to them because I don’t think there were very many people nationwide who were any further along than I was for the age. And I grew up in a family of jazz musicians so that I was used to thinking about it. It was not a — you know go to a jam session kind of thing and learn by listening. But you listen but you also have, you had to have some information behind it so you could move faster. You could improve more quickly.
So you left Woody Herman and then you ended up with Stan Kenton.
